name: addterm
title: Try all one-term additions to a Poisson glm.

origin.description: Try fitting all models that differ from the current model by adding a single term from those supplied, maintaining marginality.
origin.value: The value printed in the example.
origin.example: d <- data.frame(y=c(5,3,8,2), x1=c(0,1,1,0), x2=c(1,0,1,0)); m0 <- glm(y ~ x1, family=poisson(), data=d); as.vector(t(as.matrix(addterm(m0, ~ . + x2, test="Chisq"))))

translation.description: Try fitting all models that differ from the current model by adding a single term from those supplied, maintaining marginality.
translation.details: Checked against MASS 7.3-66. NumPy holds the arrays where the function is numeric.
translation.value: The value printed in the example.
